title: Hearty Garlicky Filipino Noodles Pancit Canton
description: A garlicky and tender Filipino dish featuring molasses, this satvik-friendly version of pancit canton is a crowd-pleaser, made with robata-grill flavors.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large wok or frying pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the shredded cabbage and grated carrots, cooking until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the robata-grill seasoning, molasses, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the wok or frying pan, stirring to combine with the vegetable mixture.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the pancit canton to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
